component.name: Volume 3
component.summary: Transparent screen zone scroll-wheel audio control

description.p: Volume 3 is a lightweight cross-platform desktop application that lets users place transparent, customizable screen overlay zones anywhere on their display. Rotating the mouse wheel over an active zone dynamically raises, lowers, or mutes audio without intercepting clicks or hovering from the windows beneath.
Initial release of Volume 3 with compact Volume2-style UI, 18 OSD styles, auto-start, and cross-platform audio control.
